digest.en: US President Donald Trump says he's "not satisfied" with a new proposal from Iran to end hostilities. The US is set to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany amid escalating tensions with NATO allies over a potential Iran war. Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE against Iran with its Iron Dome system.
digest.hi: नोबेल विजेता नरगिस मोहम्मदी की तबीयत जेल में बिगड़ गई, उन्हें अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया। इलाज में लापरवाही के आरोप लगे हैं। UN महासचिव गुटेरेस ने कहा कि पश्चिम एशिया संकट की कीमत मानवता चुका रही है।

articles.title: US Withdrawing 5,000 Troops From Germany
articles.summary: The US is withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany over six to twelve months. The Pentagon said the withdrawal was expected to be completed over the next six to twelve months.

articles.title: Trump Tells US Congress Hostilities In Iran "Have Terminated"
articles.summary: President Donald Trump told Congress that hostilities in Iran have terminated. President Donald Trump told top US lawmakers on Friday that hostilities in Iran had ended, after coming under pressure from Congress to seek authorization for the conflict as it headed into its third month.

articles.title: Israel Said to Have Helped Defend Emirates in Iran War With Iron Dome
articles.summary: Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE with its Iron Dome missile defense system during the Iran war. The Emirates bore the brunt of Iran's retaliatory attacks on Gulf countries. It appeared to be the first time the missile defense system was sent to an Arab country.

articles.title: Lebanon says 12 killed in Israeli strikes on southern town
articles.summary: Israeli strikes killed 12 people in southern Lebanon, despite a ceasefire and evacuation warnings. Lebanon said Israeli strikes killed 12 people in the south, including in a town under an evacuation warning despite a ceasefire.

articles.title: At least 12 killed in latest Israeli attacks on Lebanon
articles.summary: Israeli attacks on Lebanon killed at least 12, with over 2,600 dead since March 2. Israel's strikes continue, with more than 2,600 killed since March 2, despite an ongoing ceasefire.

articles.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
articles.summary: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

articles.title: Trump ‘Not Satisfied’ With Iran’s Proposal on Ending War
articles.summary: President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Iran's proposal to end the war. The details of the latest plan were unclear, and President Trump did not specify his objections. Trump ‘Not Satisfied’ With Iran’s Proposal on Ending War.

articles.summary: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals, part of a broader immigration crackdown. The administration had sought to cancel temporary protections for 13 countries.

articles.title: Suspect in UK Stabbing Attack on Jewish Men Faces Third Attempted Murder Charge
articles.summary: A man faces attempted murder charges for stabbing two Jewish men in London. A man appeared in court charged with the attempted murder of two Jewish men in Golders Green, in north London, and of another man, an acquaintance, elsewhere in the city.

articles.summary: The US Catholic Archdiocese will pay $800 million to settle 1,300 sex abuse cases. The settlement is second only to the $880 million deal reached by the Archdiocese of Los Angeles in 2024.

articles.title: In Packed Cafes, Iranians Yearn to Escape War’s Wreckage
articles.summary: Iranians gather in cafes to discuss hopes and fears amid uncertain times. Cafes and coffee shops give Iranians affordable places to talk about their hopes, fears and the cost of living as well as to seek company in uncertain times.

articles.title: U.S.'s Hormuz coalition 'not in competition' with France, U.K.-led bid: French FM
articles.summary: France's foreign minister said the US Hormuz coalition is not competing with theirs. The U. K. and France have led talks on a separate maritime effort, recently holding a meeting with more than 50 countries.

articles.title: Rebels take key military camp in Mali's north
articles.summary: Rebel forces captured Tessalit, a key military camp in Mali's north, without incident, according to a security source in Gao. The camp's fall marks a significant gain for the rebels in their push against government control in the region.
